posts.tagline: AUDI SHOCK EXIT! WHEATLEY TO ASTON?!
posts.title: Audi 'shock' tipped as Jonathan Wheatley exit trigger
posts.summary: Jonathan Wheatley is currently without a role following his surprise exit from Audi as its team principal. Is a move to Aston Martin on the horizon?

posts.title: Adrian Newey lining up dream Aston Martin takeover with Max Verstappen poach the end goal
posts.summary: Aston Martin technical chief Adrian Newey appears to be laying the groundwork for a reunion with some of the best talent on the F1 grid, and it could all be to improve the team's chances of poaching Max Verstappen from Red Bull.
